description: This file defines the Surveys class for SuiteCRM, extending Basic, with properties and methods for managing survey data, including saving questions and options, and retrieving matrix options and submit text.

classes.name: Surveys
classes.description: A class representing the Surveys module, handling survey data, questions, options, and related functionalities.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Checks if the class implements a specific interface, returning true for 'ACL'.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the survey object, along with associated questions and options if provided.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Saves options for a survey question, handling creation, deletion, and ordering.

methods.name: getMatrixOptions
methods.description: Returns an array of matrix options, defaulting to satisfaction levels.

methods.name: getSubmitText
methods.description: Returns the submit button text, defaulting to 'Submit'.
